notes.title: New Game Mode and some bug fixes
notes.content:
Many bug fixes

New game mode Elimination
I decided to make a new mode that is more of a quick hop in and hop out. This is a very simple mode where enemies are spawned in. You can see the amount of enemies remaining in the top right. Once you get to 3 left they will be highlighted in red even through walls.
You can set the difficulty on the level select screen. This will effect enemy count, health, speed, xp and money rewards. 
This mode unlocks at level 10. I did this to make sure the player at least has some upgrades when going in to this mode.

There is only one enemy type at the moment. I have to make new enemies with different logic for this mode which takes a bit. But this is a start.

The enemies in this mode just wander around until you either damage them or they see you. 
Crouching will make them not be able to see you until your close. 
they can not see you from behind
if they are unaware of you and you get behind and melee they will instantly die.
higher difficulties will make them be able to see you from further away


This is a very early version of this mode. I will keep a look out and keep iterating on it and add more maps for it as well.

notes.title: Major Gameplay changes
notes.content:
It's time for another big update. 

This Update changes a lot of how the overall progression works in the game.

I have always enjoyed incremental games like for example adventure capitalist. I wanted to add that to this game. 

[b]MAIN UPDATE[/b]
[list]
[*] Revamped the money system. Now any money earned in a level can be "banked" after a successful extract

[*] No more random weapons, You can buy weapons in the hub and use those until you swap or lose them.

[*] If you die in a level you will lose all weapons and will not bank the money earned

[*] If you extract you bank all the money that you have earned in that match and you will not lose your weapons.

[*] You will be given the option to extract every 3 rounds. The game only slows down when this menu is active and doesn't pause.

[*] Money can be spent in the hub to unlock new characters, buy weapons, and upgrade your stats. 

[*] Stats that can be upgraded are health, damage, money, and health regen. You can also unlock the slo-mo ability
(hovering over the buttons will show the price of the upgrade in the tooltip)

[*] When you level up you also get the money that goes to your "bank" This is to help with starting where you are more likely to die and not extract any cash. Just leveling will help you
[/list]

[b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] The hub has been updated and a bunch of issues with falling through the hub. Made it look a bit better. Made it bigger to accommodate future updates

[*] base player stats have been nerfed overall to accommodate for the new upgrades system.

[*] base weapon damage has been nerfed across the board to accommodate for new upgrades system

[*] Health packs do not auto-heal you now. The old Revive icon will now appear when you pick one up and you can use the Heal Key bind (E by default) to heal instantly) You get one for free on spawn

[*] Grenades no longer drop as one. A single box will drop that refills all grenades(you start with 1 grenade now)

[*] removed difficulty selection for now. Might look into a better way of doing this in the future

[*] some weapon sounds have been changed

[*] added a second confirm button to the delete stats button

[*] Enemy health is no longer capped. 
[/list]



I think that's most of the changes. One thing that did come to mind is that incremental games tend to make numbers meaningless after a while but hey that's part of the fun. That's what the delete stats button is for.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
This is what happens when I loose internet for a week. 
Time for a MAJOR update.

The BIGGEST update is I figured out SAVE GAMES which opened the door for many other things.
Here is a list of *everything* in this update. (I may miss some things)


Character Updates

Natalia now spawns a 1HP explosive Barrel instead of just blowing herself up (Does not damage the player or trigger knockback)

New Characters - Ember - Spawns a companion wolf Amber that attacks Enemies
Echo - Activate to set a location then activate again to teleport to that location


General Gameplay

Weapons have been removed from the buy menu and can now be obtained from the Random Weapon Terminal in the maps for 1500 points

Changed skill points to only add 1 per round. Changed needed skill points to reflect this. To unlock EVERY skill you would need to get to round 25

New Powerup - Nuke - Blows up all spawned in enemies


New Weapons - Burst Pistol, Automatic Rifle, Rubber Chicken Melee Weapon

The marksman rifle scope can now be used by pressing the sniper zoom button while aiming (default middle mouse button)
This will apply to any future weapons with scopes

Character Abilities now require a set amount of kills to use. You can see the amount needed in the bottom left bellow the ability icon

Zombie Health Buff - The max health of mutants has been raised and the rate at which their health increases has also been increased

Weapon Recoil Per shot increased across all weapons.

A keybind has been added to drop weapons - Default U Key (can be changed)

New Shooting range system in the hub. Can choose the type, distance, and health of the target.

ui updates - more simplified, uniform ui across the entire game.
updated health bars to have health number as well
main menu now requires any key press to enter the game instead of the button
changed the background of the main menu screen to game art

Post Game screens added when Extracting (more on that below) and dying. Shows simple match stats and  allows you to restart the level or return to hub

Added options to toggle Health bars and Damage numbers in the options screen (Will only take effect on newly spawned enemies) 

FOV option - Aim for new fov to take effect



Save System and Stats System

First off User settings now save. When setting your resolution, sensitivity, etc they will now save and load when opening the game.

Stats tracking has been added. The terminal can be accessed in the hub,

Using the delete stats button will completely wipe your player save inculding unlocked characters and level. (does not clear options save)

XP and Level progression/Character Unlocks

You can see your current level in the bottom right below your health along with how much xp you have and need for the next level and how many Unlock Points you have

1 Unlock point is awarded for every level gained. Every level will increase the xp needed by 50 each time. For example level 1-2 is 500 XP while level 2-3 is 1000

The default unlocked character is Nova. To unlock other characters you can unlock them with Unlock points. You can see how many points you need when hovering over the unlock button below the character portrait

Extracting is now an option in the buy menu for 50K points. This will award extra XP for the round that you extracted on. 

For example if you die on round 20 you get 100 extra xp but if you extract on round 20 you get 200xp. (These numbers may change overtime while I test the leveling system some more.


XP is awarded for kills (amount awarded depends on enemy type)

Xp is also awarded for rounds survived but this is calculated after death or extract

Playing on a higher difficulty will give you extra kill xp


I have probably missed some things and bugs are almost guaranteed to happen that I didn't catch while testing. Please leave any bug reports, feedback, or ideas on the steam community hub page. There is also a link to this page on the pause menu of the game.

notes.title: New Skills System, Damage Numbers, And bug fixes
notes.content:
Added a new System to the buy menu. A skill system. Some things from the original buy menu are now moved to this new skill system. You gain points from completing rounds. For example if you complete round 4 you will get 4 points. The current round you would need to reach to unlock every skill is round 20. 
I have tested this extensively (why it took so long to put this out) but will continue to make sure this is balanced.

A bunch of bug fixes (too many to list)

Damage numbers added. Just because. They look cool okay.

notes.title: Balance Changes, New Map, Difficulty Selection
notes.content:
New Map - Village

In testing I noticed that the game had become very easy. I decided to make the start of a match a bit more challenging but after getting upgrades the game becomes relatively easy. This adds to the power fantasy making you go from nothing to feeling almost unkillable. I am trying to make a fun satisfying game but do still want to provide some challenge. 


To provide some more needed challenge I did some VERY basic difficulty settings on the level select screen. 
Max Health, Power Up Drop Rates, and Mutant Health are affected by difficulty.

As for health on Easy you have 100, Medium is 75, and Hard is 50

The Tank zombie now does 50 damage instead of 25. I did this as the move and attack speed is very slow so it shouldn't still be too much of a threat just need to make sure to pay attention.

Removed one upgrade to the health upgrade to 3 instead of 4 for 3 extra hits.

notes.title: New Character Abilities and small balance change
notes.content:
Each Character now has their own special ability along side the slow time ability that all characters have. 

Nova - Sprint Boost - Sprint faster for a short time
Natalia - Detonate - Creates a large explosion that damages enemies in range
David - Barrier - Generates a barrier that blocks all damage
John - Smoke Cloud - Makes a smoke cloud that slows all enemies

Balance changes - As I was playing myself i started to get frustrated that i could never afford the damage upgrade so i replaced the speed upgrade and the damage upgrade prices.

Damage upgrade now costs 5k per upgrade.
Speed upgrade costs 10K for the one upgrade

notes.title: Early Access, Small Additions, QOL changes
notes.content:
First off the main thing is the game is now available to buy at a 10 percent discount for a week after launch. I am excited to finally let people play my first game and get feedback that I can use to make this game better and fun for everyone to play.

As for some of the small changes in this latest update I added a Utilities section to the buy menu to allow players to buy ammo, grenades and health. This is to hopefully reduce the frustrations of getting unlucky on the drop chances. 

I have also added two new upgrades. One that will turn on Health Regen for the duration of the match. You will heal 5 health every 5 seconds.
Unlimited ammo does what it says. It will make every weapon have unlimited ammo. This is a basic main goal to achieve while I work on something more in depth.

I have also nerfed the Max Speed of all Special zombies so they can not turn into sprinters. The regular zombies can turn into sprinters in higher rounds and the green sprinter mutant goes the fastest still. 

The electric zombie (the one that slows you) will now no longer slow you if it is dead.

Please Please Please leave feedback on what you think would make the game better and report any bugs. Do this all through the games community hub.

notes.title: Mutant Balancing and Bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with the new powerup drops to where sometimes the power up would never go away even after the 30 seconds was up.

Changed up mutant spawning logic to try and make the specials a little less annoying. Now on round 1 only regulars will spawn. and then each round after will start adding a random amount of specials. IE on round 2 there is a chance for 1 to 2 tanks to spawn and so on. 

I also made it to where less electric mutants can spawn. I like the idea of an enemy that can slow you down if to close but having 10 of them at one time was a bit to annoying, Now only a max of 3 can spawn in a round.

notes.title: New Powerup Drops
notes.content:
Added two powerups that can randomly drop when killing mutants. 

Double points and Instakill. Self explanatory. 

A bunch of small bug fixes as well in this update.

notes.title: A few small updates
notes.content:
Changed the color theme of the hub level for no reason other than I started messing around with textures. 

Weapon Balance - Changed almost  every weapons damage to be more aligned to their pricing structure. Motley buffs with a few exceptions.

notes.title: New Basic Map, Enemy Spawn Change, and more
notes.content:
In this new update I first worked on a new map. Simulation Green. 

This is a basic level with the main difference from the other levels being it is more open. I will be adding more to this level and others over time.


I have also change the spawns of the mutants. This may be changed if it becomes to much. More zombies spawn per round at random to accommodate me allowing more specials to spawn. I have made it to where about 60 percent of them are the default non specials and the rest are a random amount of each special with a max of 8 of each specials per round. 

Ex: on round 1, 3 electric zombies  and 2 tanks may spawn with the rest being normal but on round 10, 8 tanks 4 electric and two exploders may spawn with the rest being normal. 

Again this may be changed if it is too much but I wanted to try and keep the action up as much as possible even in the early rounds. 


To balance points i have also reduced the points per kill to 50 per since you will be getting more points per round on average with more being spawned.
